params.caption: 🎮 KFC turns GTA's Cluck n' Bell into a real delivery service KFC is running a limited-time Cluck n' Bell promotion inspired by the fast-food chain from Grand Theft Auto. Lucky fans will get their chicken delivered in a bright pink Cadillac that looks like it drove straight out of GTA 6. It is the latest brand stunt riding the hype just days before Rockstar's launch. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 18:17 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 👥 @RockstarGames 🍗 React if you'd order from Cluck n' Bell · 💬 Best GTA brand stunt so far? #GTA6 #CluckinBell #KFC #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
